Nelson, L., Gandrik, A., McKellar, M., Patterson, M., Robertson, E., Wood, R. and Maio, V. (2011). Integration of High Temperature Gas-Cooled Reactors into Industrial Process Applications. INL/EXT-09-16942, Revision 3, September 2011. Idaho National Laboratory, Idaho Falls, for the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Nuclear Energy (NGNP Project).

Short summary report (46 pp). Loaded: HTGR module outputs, temperature/pressure of helium and steam heat (Table 1, Table 3), capital cost assumptions per kW(t) (Sect. 2), power-cycle options (Fig. 2) and economic assumptions that map to parameters. Not loaded: process-integration balances (gasoline, diesel, ammonia, SNG, SAGD) and sensitivity-chart selling prices, kept selectively in _other-values. Tables 1-4 and Figs. 2 and 30 are images in the PDF and were read from rendered pages; numbers taken from figure labels are printed labels. Page numbers are PRINTED (PDF page = printed + 16). TRAPS: the capital costs per kW(t) carry no price year and no stated cost basis (they cover HTGR, steam generator and Rankine cycle, nth of a kind); the report title in the library list had the word "Selected", the printed title does not; Fig. 29 caption in the SAGD section repeats the synthetic diesel caption (source defect).
